limits: The selected 2018 edition has one subject label and one reported LC-classification value. It does not demonstrate multiple controlled headings on the same classified record.
The selected 1854 edition has two subject labels and no lc_classifications property; absence is not a verified lack of classification elsewhere.
The work has 75 subject strings; six are selected here, without treating mixed labels or apparent misspellings as validated subject assignments.
Linked work labels are never inherited into an edition. No holdings or physical shelf location was inspected.
Only selected factual metadata and original notes are bundled; no covers, book text, descriptive blurbs or scans are included.
